findings.location: Paragraph: “Despite God’s faithfulness... checkbook runs dry” (third paragraph)
findings.source_quote: the checkbook runs dry, the children squabble and cry, and the demands of our schedules have us hopping from one event to the next.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more idiomatic Portuguese rendering for “the checkbook runs dry.” For example: “o saldo da conta fica zerado, as crianças discutem e choram, e as exigências da nossa agenda nos fazem saltar de um evento ao outro.” This preserves meaning and registers naturally in internationally intelligible Portuguese.
findings.translation_quote: o saldo do banco seca, as crianças discutem e choram, e as exigências da nossa agenda nos fazem saltar de um evento ao outro.
